info.name: DAtuviSezaH
info.value: ayam DAtuH 'sOtraH' DAtuH asti (DAtupAWe nEva vidyate ityASayaH) . fterIyaN 3.1.29 ityatra pAWitaH ayam DAtuH svArTe IyaN-pratyayaM svIkaroti . api ca, ArDaDAtukapratyayavivakzAyAM AyAdayaH ArDaDAtuke vA 3.1.31 ityanena ayam IyaN-pratyayaH vikalpyate .

info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to pity, to hate, to criticize, to abuse, to favour

info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: sOtraH ayaM DAtuH ' takArAnto DAturayam ikA nirdizwaH, na tu ikArAntaH ' - sidDAntakOmudI . DAtupAWe apaWitaH api sUtre anuvAdAt ( fterIyaN - 3.1.29) DAtutvaM boDyam . ' sanAdyantA:...(3.1.32) iti IyaNantasya DAtutvam . ' jugupsAyAm ayaM DAtuH ' iti bahavaH . ' kfpAyAM ca ' ityeke . (ayaM DAtuH tattvaboDinIyuktAyAM kOmudyAm adAdeH AdO dattaH asti .)
